$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the influencer pack composed with a Lisbon fashion and slow-travel creator's content seed (Lua Marinho), a bordeaux brand, and the miradouro register. Everything else — builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Fashion & travel creator
description: A fashion creator's site told as a diary of evenings: Lua Marinho in Lisbon. The home opens on her walking down an Alfama stairway at golden hour under "Dressed for the last light.", then four more full-bleed photographs at the same size — Comporta, Palermo, Sintra, the river wall — each with the place, the hour, and what she wore written into the foot of the frame. After the diary: this summer's shoppable looks, her five platforms, the link hub's newest links, the audience numbers, one brand voice at pull-quote scale, and a quiet sign-off line. The filterable looks with every piece linked, the link-in-bio hub, her story, and a campaign inquiry form keep their own pages. Limestone ivory, espresso ink, and bordeaux in Noto Serif Display over Manrope. Flexes to fashion, travel, and lifestyle creators, stylists, and anyone whose work is photographed in good light.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so these links and looks seeds replace the base pack's at compose and mirror THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry, in order (looks minus the code-owned photographs) — the composed template's Manage editors open on Lua's hub and looks, not the base demo creator's. The influencer content tests pin the twin in the composed tree.

entries.title: Linen on the Alfama Stairs
entries.description: An untucked white linen shirt, wide oat trousers and a crocheted straw bag — the uniform for a city that is mostly stairs and mostly warm.

entries.title: Stripes for the Feira da Ladra

entries.title: The Ferry to Cacilhas

entries.title: Supper in the Patio
entries.description: A chocolate satin skirt, a fine black knit and a gold chain — string lights, a garden table, and a skirt that moves when the conversation does.

theme.$comment: Bordeaux as the brand: on the miradouro register the accent is the italic line, the kicker rules and the text-link asks — the photographs carry the color. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so keeping the values identical to the preset's own accents re-inks app surfaces without shifting the pages. mode light opens on the limestone ground; navigation re-pins the shared influencerShell's centered masthead to the full-width bar — the name left, the pages right — which framestack floats over the first photograph.

landing.$comment: The pin: the miradouro register and the diary home — the seed sets home.edition, so the home opens on the hero photograph (hero full-bleed-media, the headline's last line in italic), then the diary: four more photographs edge to edge at the hero's size with the place, hour and outfit written into each (gallery sequence + captionStack overlay-start), then the base's looks rail, platforms, hub teaser, metrics and one featured quote, closing on the colophon's sign-off line. Every page closes on the colophon; the inner pages keep the base's skeletons with this seed's content. resolveCatalog puts these in place of the base's pages.
